title: The Coronavirus Test Seegene Began Before Korea Had a Single Case
conflicts: Start: CNN says Chun told his team on 16 January to focus on the virus; Chun (JoongAng Ilbo) says 16 January was a discussion and the decision came on 21 January; the story gives both. Development time: about two weeks (Chun, Korea Times) vs about three weeks by CNN's dates; the story gives CNN's dated steps only. Normal approval time: 18 months (CNN) vs 12 months (Chun); the story uses Chun's figure, attributed. Countries asking: about 30 (CNN, 12 March) vs 45 (Chun to ABC, early April); both given with dates. Share of Korean testing (more than half on 3 March, about 80% on 4 April) left out. Revenue: over 1 trillion won by mid-December (Korea Herald) and 1.1252 trillion won full year (Korea Times); story says passed 1 trillion won.
notes: Euronews article on Seegene is paid partner content and was not used. Forbes Asia is blocked. Saadi's line is from a chapter on repentance and is applied by analogy. Stance: affirms.
